about: Detail layouts (docs/round2-seams.md §6): window.IODetailLayouts[id].render(container, detail, ctx). One entry per layout, pre-listed; the page loads detail/<file> only for entries with ready=true and lists every one that registered render() in the bottom-right Prototype picker. A proposal lane rewrites ONLY its own file (d1-d5 start as copies of d0) and may rename ONLY its own line (entries are blank-line separated so parallel lanes merge cleanly).
